Алгоритм подбора ограниченной палитры. K: Algorithm for choosing a limited palette. K-means groups similar colours; MiniBatch uses approximate grouping; ImageQuant uses its own quantisation. Compare the result on your image.
Убирает слишком маленькие цветные област: Removes colour areas that are too small. Merging single dots as well reduces tiny strokes but may remove small details. The minimum area sets the size of such areas.

Extra cleanup of single dots. Reduces noise and tiny strokes but may remove wanted details.
Определяет порядок отдельных областей од: Decides the order of separate areas of one colour: large first, small first, or nearest to the previous area. Shortening moves and extra reordering work only with nearest areas.
Chooses the path used to fill an area. Automatic picks the path; Hilbert curve and Fermat spiral force a specific one. Judge the result in the target program.
Объединяет соседние шаги на прямой в дли: Joins neighbouring steps on a straight line into one long stroke. Can reduce the number of moves; the drawing program must keep up with such a stroke.
Ищет соединения между участками внутри т: Looks for connections between parts of the same colour to lift the pen less often.
Работает при очередности «Ближайшие обла: Works with the “Nearest areas” order. Refines the order to cut empty travel. Route preparation may take longer.
Works with the “Nearest areas” order. Reorders areas further to cut travel. This adds work during preparation.

Способ поиска ближайшего доступного цвет: How the nearest available colour is found in the manual palette. It affects matching with your samples.
Способ измерять различие оттенков при по: How shade differences are measured when picking a palette colour. Plain distance is simpler; CIEDE2000 uses a more complex colour difference.

Бережный режим осторожнее выбирает места: Gentle mode picks places to fix more carefully; aggressive may redraw more. Works when gap fixing is on.

Interception — сторонний драйвер ввода (: Interception is a third-party input driver by Francisco Lopes. It is not part of OlegPainter: we do not develop it and are not responsible for how it works or for its bugs.
У драйвера бывают серьёзные сбои: после: The driver can fail badly: after a mouse or keyboard is reconnected, input may stop until a restart, and in rare cases Windows has to be repaired. Install it only if you accept this risk.
Запустится официальный установщик с кома: The author's official installer will run with the uninstall command. Administrator rights and a restart are needed. Without the driver the program cannot draw.
Запустится официальный установщик автора: The author's official installer will run. Windows will ask for administrator rights, and a restart is needed afterwards. You can remove the driver on the Help page.
Откроется страница автора: скачайте Inte: The author's page will open: download Interception.zip and follow the instructions. A restart is needed after installing.

Удаление драйвера запущено. Когда устано: Driver removal started. When the installer finishes, restart the computer.
Запустите «install-interception.exe /uni: Run “install-interception.exe /uninstall” as administrator and restart the computer.
